title: fix: LA settings.snapshot models advertise LiteLLM lanyard-auto/simple/moderate/complex pins
description:
## Context

Ship-QA **lp-uxy.15.9** (shipped lp-uxy.8 + lp-uxy.12) against http://demo.localhost:3010
with Brain RPC → Lanyard Agent.

## Observation

| Surface | Result |
|---------|--------|
| Composer Auto/Simple/Moderate/Complex selector | **PASS** |
| LiteLLM proxy (`127.0.0.1:4001`) model list | **has** lanyard-simple, lanyard-moderate, lanyard-complex, lanyard-reasoning, lanyard-auto, grok-4.5 |
| `GET /api/settings/snapshot` models[] | **only** `[{provider: litellm, model: grok-4.5, is_active: true}]` |
| Portal `data-model` for all tiers | `grok-4.5` (client_fallback per ADR 0007) |

Portal correctly prefers LiteLLM intelligence model_name ids **only when they appear
in the host catalog** (`resolveLiteLlmIntelligenceModel` / ADR 0007). With a single
`grok-4.5` catalog entry, every tier falls back to client heuristic + that model —
bypassing `lanyard-auto` auto_router and tier pins.

## Expected (host)

When LA is configured with LiteLLM (`config.yaml` litellm.base_url) and the proxy
advertises intelligence pins (deploy/litellm/config.yaml seed: lanyard-auto +
lanyard-simple|moderate|complex), **settings.snapshot.models** must include those
model_name entries (not only default_model / active model).

## Done when

- settings.snapshot.models includes at least lanyard-auto, lanyard-simple,
  lanyard-moderate, lanyard-complex with provider litellm when proxy lists them
- Composer intelligence selector `data-model` for Auto → lanyard-auto, Simple →
  lanyard-simple, etc.
- Send path set_active / active model uses the selected LiteLLM pin
- Live re-QA of lp-uxy.15.9 reports litellm_routing_ok=true / verdict PASS

## Evidence

artifacts/ui/lp-uxy-ship-qa/model-selector/ (PASS_FAIL.md, REPORT.json, screenshots 01–09)
LiteLLM local config: ~/.lanyard-agent/litellm/config.local.yaml
LA config: ~/.lanyard-agent/config.yaml (default_model grok-4.5, litellm base_url :4001)

## Supersedes

title: fix: LA dual-emit parent_subagent_id for nested tool_progress under subagents
description:
## Problem

Live Web UI QA (lp-uxy.15.2) on demo.localhost:3010 against Lanyard Agent:

- Multi-subagent chips render (Explorer + Coder / helper agents).
- Subagent activity detail opens correctly.
- Nested tool stream stays empty: "No nested tools were reported for this run."
  even when the subagent completed work (result body present).

Portal consumer (lp-uxy.1) correctly filters nested tools by `parent_subagent_id`
(aliases: `subagent_run_id`, `parent_subagent_run_id`). Story fixture
`?story=activity-plane&phase=nested` proves the UI path works when attribution
is present.

## Expected (host contract)

When a subagent runs child tools, host dual-emits `tool_progress` with:

- stable `tool_call_id` for the child tool
- `parent_subagent_id` = parent SubagentRun id (= that subagent's `tool_call_id`)

See `portal/artifacts/hermes-lanyard-tool-citations-contract.md` (lp-uxy.1).

## Evidence

artifacts/ui/lp-uxy-ship-qa/nested-tools/:

- 01–04: story PASS (nested stream with Live tools)
- 12–15: live LA FAIL (chips + detail; nested empty-running / empty-complete)

## Acceptance

- Live multi-subagent chat shows nested tool rows in SubagentDetail while running
- Completed nested tools remain after subagent finishes
- Re-run lp-uxy.15.2 live path green

lp-uxy.16

title: fix: LA settings.snapshot models advertise LiteLLM lanyard-auto/simple/moderate/complex pins
description:
## Context

Ship-QA **lp-uxy.15.9** (shipped lp-uxy.8 + lp-uxy.12) against http://demo.localhost:3010
with Brain RPC → Lanyard Agent.

## Observation

| Surface | Result |
|---------|--------|
| Composer Auto/Simple/Moderate/Complex selector | **PASS** |
| LiteLLM proxy (`127.0.0.1:4001`) model list | **has** lanyard-simple, lanyard-moderate, lanyard-complex, lanyard-reasoning, lanyard-auto, grok-4.5 |
| `GET /api/settings/snapshot` models[] | **only** `[{provider: litellm, model: grok-4.5, is_active: true}]` |
| Portal `data-model` for all tiers | `grok-4.5` (client_fallback per ADR 0007) |

Portal correctly prefers LiteLLM intelligence model_name ids **only when they appear
in the host catalog** (`resolveLiteLlmIntelligenceModel` / ADR 0007). With a single
`grok-4.5` catalog entry, every tier falls back to client heuristic + that model —
bypassing `lanyard-auto` auto_router and tier pins.

## Expected (host)

When LA is configured with LiteLLM (`config.yaml` litellm.base_url) and the proxy
advertises intelligence pins (deploy/litellm/config.yaml seed: lanyard-auto +
lanyard-simple|moderate|complex), **settings.snapshot.models** must include those
model_name entries (not only default_model / active model).

## Done when

- settings.snapshot.models includes at least lanyard-auto, lanyard-simple,
  lanyard-moderate, lanyard-complex with provider litellm when proxy lists them
- Composer intelligence selector `data-model` for Auto → lanyard-auto, Simple →
  lanyard-simple, etc.
- Send path set_active / active model uses the selected LiteLLM pin
- Live re-QA of lp-uxy.15.9 reports litellm_routing_ok=true / verdict PASS

## Evidence

artifacts/ui/lp-uxy-ship-qa/model-selector/ (PASS_FAIL.md, REPORT.json, screenshots 01–09)
LiteLLM local config: ~/.lanyard-agent/litellm/config.local.yaml
LA config: ~/.lanyard-agent/config.yaml (default_model grok-4.5, litellm base_url :4001)
